name: 10 Summers Ago
source:
As you leave work to go on a blind date, your prince charming is not what you expected...he knows your darkest secret, one you have ran away from until now. But the real question is, who is he? 

[From [url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/10-summers-ago]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你下班去相亲时，你的白马王子并不是你想象的那样……他知道你最黑暗的秘密，一个你至今一直逃避的秘密。但真正的问题是，他是谁？

[来自[url=https://sayorii430.itch.io/10-summers-ago]itch.io[/url]]
